expectedRed.testName: DEFECT: a detached node silently passes the guard (unanalyzable input treated as visible)
expectedRed.why: The guard must raise (indeterminate) when it cannot read the style; the defected body falls through to 'visible' — the proof asserts this defect is present.

expectedRed.testName: DEFECT: unresolved (empty) computed values silently pass the guard (treated as 'nothing hides it')
expectedRed.why: The guard must raise (indeterminate) when the reader returns the engine's unresolved marker (empty strings); the defected body falls through to 'visible' — the proof asserts this defect is present.
